messages.app.title: The Watchers
messages.app.intro: People, organizations and whatever comes next. Explore entries, follow connections and build your collection.
messages.catalog.placeholder: Find a name, a detail, a connection…
messages.workspace.title: Your workspace
messages.workspace.intro: Keep the things you use close at hand. Choose your panels, create entries and make this space your own.
messages.workspace.warning: Public exports include permitted collection data and referenced images. Private data is excluded; use an encrypted vault backup to preserve it.
messages.workspace.importConfirm: Replace your current working collection with this file? Export a backup first.
messages.workspace.data: Edit connections, sources and notes JSON
messages.workspace.exported: Snapshot downloaded. Follow the README to publish it.
messages.workspace.typeCreated: Type created. It is now available in the entry editor.
messages.workspace.format: Supports v1.0 snapshots and v1.1 collections in a complete public package. Upload files travel with the package.
messages.editor.title: New Entry
messages.editor.label: Field label
messages.editor.listHint: Use a JSON array, for example ["blue", "green"].
messages.editor.referenceHint: Use object UUIDs. Lists use a JSON array.
messages.editor.noFields: Add a field to start. Choose from your existing fields or create a custom field.
messages.editor.typeIdHint: Lowercase letters, numbers, underscores or hyphens. Start with a letter.
messages.editor.metadataHelp: Edit the full object JSON, including field rules and source IDs. UUID and creation timestamp cannot be changed here.
messages.editor.registryHelp: Disable a type with enabled: false. In-use types cannot be removed. Add label keys to the language catalog before using them.
messages.editor.relatedHelp: The three arrays are validated together, including references. Use object UUIDs for endpoints.
messages.editor.duplicateField: This suggested field has already been added.
messages.detail.legacy: Original record preserved in the export
messages.status.failure: The collection could not be loaded. Check the deployment files and try again.
messages.status.noscript: Enable JavaScript to explore this collection.
messages.error.label: An en-US label is required at {path}.
messages.error.range: Value or date interval is out of range at {path}.
messages.error.disabled: This type is disabled for new entries.
messages.error.integrity: Files from different builds were detected. Reload after deployment completes.
messages.error.json: The JSON could not be read.
messages.error.unknown: The action could not be completed. Your previous draft is unchanged.
messages.field.name: Name
messages.workspace.emptyConfirm: Remove all entries, connections, sources and notes from this draft? Export first to keep a copy.
messages.workspace.emptied: Empty public collection created. Types and field definitions are retained.
messages.error.http: HTTP {status} while loading {path}. Check the server root and deployment files.
messages.status.sourceRoot: This is the source project. Serve the dist directory over HTTP, or open the built application below.
messages.workspace.deviceSaved: Workspace changes saved on this device. Public changes are not published until the PR is merged and deployed.
messages.workspace.visibilityHelp: Show or hide panels in your workspace. This does not delete entries or hide public information. Changes are saved automatically on this device.
messages.workspace.emptyTitle: A little space to make your own.
messages.workspace.emptyHelp: All optional panels start hidden. Add the sections, types or entries you want to keep nearby.
messages.workspace.layoutHelp: Layout preferences are separate from collection data. To share a default layout, place the exported visible list in config/workspace.json → defaults, then rebuild.
messages.workspace.resetConfirm: Discard your local collection changes and return to the published data? Export a backup first.
messages.workspace.storageFailed: Changes are currently held in this tab only. Browser storage may be full, blocked or changed in another tab. Export a backup before closing or reloading.
messages.workspace.recoveryHelp: A saved draft could not be applied automatically. It may belong to a different deployment. Download it before restoring or clearing it; restore replaces the working collection.
messages.workspace.recoveryNotice: A previous local draft needs review in Settings. New changes cannot be saved on this device until it is resolved.
messages.workspace.restoreConfirm: Replace the working collection with the previous local draft?
messages.workspace.clearConfirm: Permanently clear the saved local draft? Export any work you need first.
messages.editor.englishLabel: The base label is written in English. Interface translations are managed in Languages.
messages.editor.changeKind: Changing the field type will clear its current value. Continue?
messages.editor.fieldAdded: Field added to this form. Save Entry to keep your changes.
messages.editor.sharedField: This field uses a shared definition. Its data type is fixed.
messages.editor.discard: Discard unsaved changes in this form?
messages.source.title: Title
messages.source.unlink: Remove all references to this source
messages.error.sourceInUse: This source is used in {count} records. Choose a replacement or explicitly remove its references.
messages.settings.advancedHelp: These tools edit the underlying data. Everyday tasks are available through forms.
messages.type.help: These are suggestions, not required fields. Each entry may have its own fields. New types receive a permanent internal ID automatically.
messages.type.disabled: Unavailable for new entries; existing entries are preserved.
messages.language.title: Languages
messages.language.help: Keep en-US as the base. Import a language file or create a translation. Incomplete languages stay as drafts until all messages and variables are valid.
messages.language.replaceConfirm: Replace the existing translation draft for this language? The enabled language stays unchanged until you apply it.
messages.language.disableConfirm: Remove this language from the selector? Its translation will remain as a draft.
messages.language.translationHelp: Edit the translation beside each English source message. Keep every variable exactly as shown. This changes interface text, not entry values.
messages.language.activated: Language applied. It is available in the header.
messages.architecture.intro: Independent versions let the collection evolve while preserving the identity of its records.
messages.architecture.note: The static site reads public JSON files. Local drafts are separate from publication. File hashes detect mixed builds; they do not authenticate the publisher.
messages.error.options: Add at least one choice for this field.
messages.error.translation: Complete or correct {count} messages before enabling this language.
messages.error.storageConflict: Another tab changed the local draft. Export your current work, then reload before saving again.
messages.layerHelp.application: The features and workflows available in this release.
messages.layerHelp.theme: The visual identity, spacing and responsive components.
messages.layerHelp.object: Individual records, their identity and typed fields.
messages.layerHelp.snapshot: The portable collection used for backup and import.
messages.layerHelp.language: Interface messages and their named variables.
messages.layerHelp.index: Lightweight records for search and lazy loading.
messages.layerHelp.ui: The structure expected by the interface and theme.
messages.layerHelp.workspace: Personal visibility, local drafts and translation drafts.
messages.source.panelHelp: Create, organize and connect the sources behind your information.
messages.language.panelHelp: Load a language or translate interface messages manually.
messages.extension.unavailable: This feature is disabled. Open Plugins to enable it.
messages.editor.patternHelp: Optional. Match the entire value. Examples: [0-9]+ or [A-Za-z]+. Nested groups and lookarounds are not supported.
messages.error.pattern: The value at {path} does not match the field pattern.
messages.error.patternSyntax: The pattern at {path} is invalid or unsupported.
messages.kernel.pluginHelp: Enable the capabilities you need. Disabling a plugin keeps its data. Changes take effect after reloading.
messages.kernel.disableAllConfirm: Start with only the core? Your collection and local drafts will be kept.
messages.kernel.updateHelp: Check for updates from your chosen HTTPS registries. This release only reads metadata; installation and publication are manual.
messages.kernel.incompatible: Requires a different core or API version
messages.kernel.install: Install a local plugin or theme
messages.kernel.installHelp: Extract a trusted package into a folder, run the command in your project, then run npm run build. Exported configuration can replace config/extensions.json to publish your choices.
messages.kernel.trustHelp: Plugins run with page privileges. Declared API capabilities are not a security sandbox. Only install code you trust.
messages.kernel.themeHelp: Choose a presentation. Entry data and validation stay with plugins.
messages.kernel.builtinHelp: Minimal presentation, without an installed theme.
messages.kernel.themeFailure: Could not load the theme; using the core presentation.
messages.kernel.saved: Saved on this device. Export configuration to include it in the next build.
messages.kernel.storageUnavailable: Local storage is unavailable. Enable browser storage to save extension preferences.
messages.kernel.storageConflict: Another tab changed these preferences. Reload before saving.
messages.kernel.recovery: Stored extension preferences could not be applied. Project defaults were loaded. Export the saved preferences before resetting.
messages.kernel.resetConfirm: Reset only extension preferences? Collection drafts will be kept.
messages.fieldKey.help: Stable semantic key, for example field.passport. Internal IDs remain unchanged.
messages.media.uploadHelp: PNG, JPEG, WebP or GIF. Up to 10 MiB each, 60 MiB per package. Uploads are stored in the encrypted vault; unlock it first.
messages.privacy.visualHelp: Hidden and masked affect presentation only. Select Private to exclude a value from publication.
messages.privacy.entryHelp: Private entries and private fields are excluded from public exports and GitHub. Private data requires an unlocked vault. Existing entries keep their classification.
messages.vault.title: Privacy & Vault
messages.vault.help: The vault encrypts your full workspace and uploaded images on this device. Use at least 12 characters. Keep an encrypted backup and your passphrase separately; losing both access and the passphrase means losing the private data.
messages.vault.restore: Restore encrypted backup (enter its passphrase above)
messages.vault.restoreConfirm: Replace the current vault with this encrypted backup?
messages.badges.name: Badge name
messages.badges.needMedia: Enable Media to edit image badges. Emoji badges work independently.
messages.badges.help: Create reusable badges, then select them individually in New Entry or Edit. Legacy type assignments remain as defaults only for older entries without an individual selection.
messages.settings.projectScope: Project settings — included in public exports and GitHub changes.
messages.settings.localScope: Personal settings — saved only in this browser.
messages.github.help: Configure owner, repository and destination in Settings. Grant Contents: Read and write and Pull requests: Read and write for this repository. The token is kept only in memory. A PR saves to a new branch; merge and successful deployment update the site.
messages.github.review: Step 2: review these public file changes, then click Create pull request.
messages.github.noChanges: No public changes to submit. Private entries and local settings are excluded. Connecting alone does not create a PR.
messages.github.author: Commit author name
messages.github.title: Pull request title
messages.github.confirmPrompt: Submit the reviewed changes from {branch} to {base}?
messages.github.sending: Creating the commit and pull request…
messages.github.sent: Pull request created. Use the link below if the new tab did not open. Waiting for manual review and merge.
messages.vault.locked: Vault locked — private data is unavailable until you unlock it.
messages.badges.title: Badges
messages.badges.pickerHelp: New entries start empty. Type a name and press Enter to select or create a badge. Saved with this entry.
messages.catalog.noDescription: Explore this entry and its connections.
messages.badges.duplicate: A badge with this name already exists. Select the existing badge.
messages.badges.colorHelp: Choose the background color. Text contrast adjusts automatically; image and emoji colors are preserved.
messages.badges.colorInvalid: Use a six-digit hex color, such as #16783a.
messages.fieldFormat.label: Number format
messages.fieldFormat.help: Year keeps the integer value and displays it without thousands separators.
messages.fieldPicker.label: Fields
messages.fieldPicker.help: Type and press Enter to select an existing field or create a reusable text field. Save the form to keep your changes. Use Custom field for other value types and rules.
messages.fieldPicker.ambiguous: More than one field matches this name. Choose the intended field from the suggestions.
messages.badges.dimensionsHelp: Sizes are in pixels. Width 0 is automatic; height is a minimum so text stays readable. Background color is configured above.
messages.badges.styleInvalid: Check badge dimensions and border values. Use the ranges shown in each field.
messages.github.ready: Step 1: enter your token and connect. This step only reviews changes; it does not create a PR.
messages.github.connecting: Connecting to GitHub and checking your identity…
messages.github.preparing: Preparing public files and comparing them with the destination branch…
messages.github.failed: The operation could not be completed. Review the error above and retry.
messages.github.tokenRequired: Enter a fine-grained token and connect. If authentication failed, enter a valid token again.
messages.github.awaitingConfirmation: Step 3: confirm the submission below to create the branch and pull request.
messages.github.conflictHelp: Your build and the destination branch have different source files. Export your local work before updating the deployed project. After merging a PR, wait for deployment and reload before making the next edit. Review the conflict details before proceeding.
messages.picker.placeholder: Type to search; press Enter to select or create…
messages.picker.help: Typing only searches. Press Enter to select an exact match or create a new item.
messages.picker.ambiguous: Several entries have that name. Select the intended result.
messages.picker.chooseType: Choose the type of entry to create.
messages.fields.inUse: This field is in use. Its value type and identifier are preserved; changed rules must validate all existing values.
messages.categories.title: Categories
messages.categories.name: Category name
messages.categories.invalid: Enter a category name of up to 80 characters and a description of up to 2000.
messages.categories.duplicate: A category with this name already exists.
messages.categories.help: Categories classify entries, such as Singer, Actor, Founder or Developer. Changes apply when you save.
messages.language.flagHelp: Flags are optional. Keep a language name; a language is not limited to one country.
messages.language.flagInvalid: Enter a valid display name and emoji or public image.
messages.css.previewHelp: Isolated sample preview. Actual theme layout may differ. Save and open the catalog to see the applied styles.
messages.css.imported: Imported into this draft. Save to apply.
messages.css.help: Style the catalog and profiles. Settings, Plugins, Themes and Docs remain available without custom CSS. Export JSON to include uploaded images; CSS exports contain only rules. Use #app, .card, .card-body, .card-title, .badge and .category-tag as selectors.
messages.catalog.startEmpty: Your collection is empty. Create your first entry to get started.
